text: おさげの　おんなのこが　れんがの　みちを　あるいてる…　…もう　いかなきゃ！

structure.jp: おさげの　おんなのこが
れんがの　みちを　あるいてる…
structure.en: is walking down a brick road...

patterns.name: 〜なければならない
patterns.explanation: なければならない on a verb means 'have to do it'. In casual talk it shrinks to なきゃ and the rest is dropped. いかなきゃ = 'I've got to go'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb says the action is going on right now. Here it is shortened to てる, as people do when talking. あるいてる = 'is walking'.

patterns.name: 〜を (path)
patterns.span: みちを　あるいてる
patterns.explanation: を with a moving verb shows the place you move along or through. みちを　あるいてる = 'is walking down the road'.
